pvs_title: Amends and Reforms the State Cannabis Control Commission
evidence: PVS lists the House vote of June 4, 2025 (Bill Passed, 154-0; PVS bill 40732, vote 111516) under H 4240, which is the FY2026 budget (https://malegislature.gov/Bills/194/H4240); the June 30 H 4240 rows (PVS bill 40814) are correct. The bill text PVS attaches to the vote (https://static.votesmart.org/static/billtext/111516.pdf) is House No. 4187, and the 154-0 tally is roll call 54 on H.4187 (Amendment 36). The House then reprinted H.4187 as amended as H.4206 and passed it 153-0 the same day (https://malegislature.gov/Bills/194/H4206). H4187 and H4206 are both excluded from MA's LES (committee sponsor, no sponsor), so the choice between them does not change scores.
